department: LKS Faculty of Medicine — School of Biomedical Sciences (Neuroscience)

deadline.value: Main Round deadline is December 1, 2026 (HKPFS deadline is December 1, 2026 at noon HKT; 1st Clearing Round: April 30, 2027; 2nd Clearing Round: August 31, 2027).
deadline.quote: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme: 1 December 2026 (HKT noon, GMT+8) | Main Round: 1 December 2026 (HKT 23:59, GMT+8)

gre_subject.value: Not required for STEM PhD programs (GRE Subject Test in Psychology >= 550 is required only for Department of Psychology applicants whose first degree is not in Psychology; GRE General/GMAT is required only for Business and Economics).
gre_subject.quote: Faculty of Business and Economics applicants are required to demonstrate their capability for graduate studies by obtaining satisfactory scores in the Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT) or Graduate Record Examinations (GRE), taken within five years | Department of Psychology applicants whose first degree is not in Psychology are required to obtain a minimum score of 550 in the GRE’s Subject Test in Psychology taken within five years

supervisor.value: HKU Graduate School treats contacting a potential supervisor before applying as optional.

funding.value: Eligible full-time PhD students receive Postgraduate Scholarships (HK$19,135/month; HK$19,655/month after confirmation, wef 1/9/2026), HKU-PS, or HKPF, plus HKUMed entrance scholarships and travel grants.
funding.quote: Financial support is a key feature, with eligible students receiving prestigious scholarships such as the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship (HKPF) or HKU Presidential PhD Scholarship (HKU-PS), offering monthly stipends, cash awards, and tuition fee waivers. The Postgraduate Scholarship (PGS) provides additional financial assistance.

also.quote: The basic level of scholarship is HK$19,135 per month (wef 1/9/2026).

entry_route.value: Admits First Class Honours bachelor's holders or 2:1 honours + taught master's holders to the 4-year PhD, and 2:1 honours + research MPhil holders to the 3-year PhD.
entry_route.quote: 3-year PhD: | Bachelor's degree with Honours at Second Class Division I or above, AND a research Master's degree (MPhil). | 4-year PhD: | Bachelor's degree at First Class Honours (preferably with research experience); | Bachelor's degree with Honours at Second Class Division I, AND a taught Master's degree (preferably with Second Class Honours Division I).

notes: School of Biomedical Sciences conducts Neuroscience PhD research (neural circuits, neurodevelopment, neurodegeneration) under HKUMed without a GRE Subject Test. Separately, the Department of Psychology offers a PhD track in Human Neuroscience and Artificial Intelligence (https://psychology.hku.hk/research-degrees-mphil-phd/), for which applicants whose first degree is not in Psychology must submit a minimum score of 550 on the GRE Subject Test in Psychology.
